title: Do not install
body: This app is a scam. You cannot view anything to decide on if you want to continue until you subscribe. Also, once you enter a template of habits/ routines, there is no option to edit the habit activity or delete the ones you don’t need from the template (they claim you can do this). Deleted this the same day.
